method: Independent stdlib HTMLParser DOM extraction of image hrefs, result headings and page cursors from retained HTML; no imports or execution of recovery code; no network calls; independently reconstructed source-key joins and UTC dates.

checks.name: Centre-Ouest all declared images listed once
Centre-Sud all declared images listed once
Plateau-Central all declared images listed once
independent DOM links equal CSV membership
source key belongs to one region only
every join and original field reconstructed correctly

inference_limits: Links establish membership in a public region search result, not independently verified GPS or planting location.
Timestamp/photo source identity is not plant identity or plot identity.
Different regions on the same UTC day may reflect multiple collectors; this is not by itself a joining error.
Unmatched cases may be systematically distributed by class/day; report missingness, do not impute regions.
This is metadata recovery for an existing cohort, not an independently collected validation cohort or new pathology adjudication.
No image content or model outcome was evaluated.
